slots.notes: Fullscreen looping muted autoplaying object-cover hero background video sitting behind all content under a black overlay (bg-black/60) for text legibility. The single signature media asset. Played through a robust BackgroundVideo component using hls.js for Chrome/Firefox with native HLS for Safari; it auto-plays, loops, mutes, plays inline, and fades the poster out once playback actually starts to avoid black flashes. Native source is a Mux HLS .m3u8 manifest.

Poster/thumbnail still shown over the video container until the stream starts playing, then faded out to prevent a black flash. Should match the first frame / mood of the background video. Native placeholder is a Cloudflare Stream thumbnail .jpg.

Navbar brand mark on the left: a 'Command'-style glyph centered inside a solid white rounded square container. Sourced from lucide-react by default; supply as a currentColor/transparent icon that reads dark-on-white inside the white tile.
Small 'ChevronDown' glyph next to the 'Services' nav item indicating a dropdown. Single reused mark from lucide-react; supply as a currentColor/transparent white icon that reads on the dark video.

Hamburger 'Menu' toggle shown on mobile that opens a full-screen black overlay with vertical links. Single glyph from lucide-react (paired with a close glyph when open); supply as a currentColor/transparent white icon.
Sans heading face for the large ~76px desktop headline ('Your Networks.' / 'One Rapid Interface.'). Native family 'Inter', loaded via Google Fonts CSS import.
Global UI sans applied throughout the section (nav links, subtext, default body). Native family 'Manrope', loaded via Google Fonts CSS import.
Buttons and badges face used on the CTA labels and the glassmorphism announcement pill text. Native family 'Cabin', loaded via Google Fonts CSS import.
Serif italic accent face for the single emphasized word 'Interface' inside the second headline line. Native family 'Instrument Serif', loaded via Google Fonts CSS import.

mechanic: A fullscreen dark 'Linear-style' hero centers a glassmorphism announcement pill, a two-line ~76px headline with one Instrument-Serif-italic accent word, muted subtext and two layered CTA pills (purple primary, dark-navy secondary) over a looping muted hls.js background video dimmed by a 60% black overlay, under a glass navbar that collapses into a full-screen black overlay menu on mobile.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS, with lucide-react for icons and the hls.js library driving a custom BackgroundVideo component (hls.js for Chrome/Firefox, native HLS for Safari, poster fade-out on play) over a native <video>; Inter, Manrope, Cabin and Instrument Serif loaded via Google Fonts CSS import.
reskinNotes: The schema only exposes display/body/mono/accent font roles, so the serif italic accent face 'Instrument Serif' is parked in the 'mono' slot despite being a serif (it carries the emphasized word 'Interface', not monospace UI). The palette is declared as raw hexes/rgba with explicit hover variants that are not separate roles (purple #7b39fc hover #6a2ce0, dark-navy #2b2344 hover #352b54), so retinting buttons means editing both the base and hover values; #2b2344/#352b54 (the secondary CTA fill) has no colorRole slot and is dropped from colorRoles. The glass border rgba(164,132,215,0.5) and glass background rgba(85,80,110,0.4) are specific glassmorphism values tuned for dark-on-video. The ~76px headline sizing is tuned to Inter's metrics and the specific two-line copy and will reflow on a font swap. All copy is hardcoded in JSX: logo is the 'Command' icon, nav 'Home / Services / Reviews / Contact us', 'Sign In' and 'Get Started', badge tag 'New' + 'Say Hello to Datacore v3.2', headline 'Your Networks.' / 'One Rapid Interface.' (with 'Interface' as the serif-italic accent word), the 'Platform helps admins...' subtext, and the 'Book a Free Demo' / 'Get Started Now' CTAs. Asset URLs (Mux .m3u8 video, Cloudflare Stream .jpg poster) are placeholders to be replaced with brand media.
